auto_accept.active: Files from anyone with the right PIN are accepted without asking. Change it in the PIN card or the settings.
auto_accept.needs_pin: Auto-accept from everyone needs a receive PIN of at least 8 characters. Until you set one, only favorites are accepted automatically.

error.already_running: Another controller is already using the socket.
error.bad_address: Enter an address like 192.168.1.20 or phone.lan:53317.
error.bad_controller: {path} did not report a localsend-controller version.
error.bad_path: Not an existing file or folder: {path}
error.bad_selection: The file picker returned an invalid path. Nothing was sent.
error.clipboard_changed: The clipboard changed after the preview or could not be read, so nothing was sent. Open the preview again.
error.clipboard_secret: The clipboard holds a password from a password manager, so it was not sent.
error.data_not_private: The plugin data folder could not be made private, so the PIN was not saved.
error.device_unreachable: No LocalSend device answered at {address}. Check that LocalSend is open there with encryption on.
error.extra_exists: {path} already exists with other content, so it was left alone. Remove or rename it and switch the setting off and on.
error.extra_kept: Files changed after the plugin installed them were left in place: {path}
error.insufficient_space: Not enough free space in the save folder. The transfer was not accepted.
error.line_break: A file name contains a line break. Send that file from the panel or the terminal instead.
error.no_data_dir: Noctalia gave this plugin no data folder.
error.no_paths: Nothing to send. Give absolute paths, one per line.
error.no_ready: The receiver did not start in time.
error.no_terminal: No terminal found. Copy the command and run it in a terminal.
error.no_zenity: zenity, needed to pick files, is not installed.
error.old_controller: localsend-controller {found} is too old; this plugin needs {needed}.
error.picker_open: A file picker is already open.
error.pin_locked: Too many wrong PINs. LocalSend on the receiver has to restart before you can try again.
error.pin_required: The receiver asks for a PIN.
error.port_busy: Could not open port {port}. Close the LocalSend app or change the port in settings.
error.receive_stalled: The sender stopped sending, so the transfer was cancelled.

launcher.visibility_words: visibility visible hide hidden favorites widoczność ukryj

notify.device_added: Found {name}. Pin it to keep it in the list.
notify.pin_invalid: Wrong PIN for {name}. Try again in the panel.
notify.pin_required: {name} asks for a PIN. Enter it in the panel to send again.
notify.text_copied: Message from {name} copied to the clipboard
notify.title: LocalSend Plus

panel.add_desc: For networks where devices cannot find each other. This device introduces itself to that address.
panel.clip_empty: The clipboard is empty or holds no text.
panel.files_not_local: The clipboard holds links that are not local files, so nothing can be sent.
panel.impostor: This is not your pinned device, even though it has the same name.
panel.install_hint: Build it from the sources that come with this plugin. The update script checks for Rust and a C compiler, tells you how to install what is missing, builds the controller and restarts LocalSend. You can also run it from any terminal:
panel.no_devices: No devices found. Open LocalSend on another device on this network.
panel.offline: Device not confirmed recently. Refresh first.
panel.pin_auto: Pin to favorites. Files from favorites are accepted without asking.
panel.reported_alias: The device now reports the name: {name}
panel.send_clipboard: Send the clipboard (text or copied files) to {name}
panel.text_hint: Accepting copies the text to the clipboard.
panel.text_long: The preview shows only the beginning; the clipboard gets all of it ({size}). Check it before pasting into a terminal.
panel.title: LocalSend Plus

pin.auto: Accept files without asking when the PIN is right (text still asks)
pin.desc: Senders must enter this PIN before their request reaches you. It is stored only on this computer. Three wrong tries from one address block that address until the receiver restarts; a sender that changes addresses can keep guessing, so use at least 8 characters if you accept files without asking.

alias.description: Name other devices see. Empty picks a random name once, like the LocalSend app does, so your hostname stays private.
alias.label: Device name

auto_accept.description: Accept incoming files without asking. Text messages always ask. From favorites is the default. From everyone needs a receive PIN of at least 8 characters (the PIN card has the same switch); until then it acts as from favorites.
auto_accept.label: Auto-accept files

controller_path.description: localsend-controller to run. Empty looks in PATH, ~/.cargo/bin and ~/.local/bin.
controller_path.label: Controller path

device_model.description: Shown to other devices under the name. Empty uses your distribution's name.
device_model.label: Device model

dolphin_menu.description: Adds "Send with LocalSend Plus" to Dolphin's menu for files and folders. Turning it off removes the entry again.
dolphin_menu.label: Dolphin context menu

nautilus_menu.description: Adds "Send with LocalSend Plus" to the Scripts submenu of Nautilus (Files) for files and folders. Turning it off removes the entry again.
nautilus_menu.label: Nautilus context menu

nemo_menu.description: Adds "Send with LocalSend Plus" to Nemo's menu for files and folders. Turning it off removes the entry again.
nemo_menu.label: Nemo context menu

port.description: Close the LocalSend app first if it uses the same port.
port.label: LocalSend port

terminal_command.description: Adds "localsend FILE... [DEVICE]" as ~/.local/bin/localsend, with Tab completion for fish, bash and zsh (zsh needs one fpath line, see the README). Your shell config stays untouched; turning this off removes the files again.
terminal_command.label: localsend command in the terminal

visibility.description: Who can find you and send you files. A change here applies at once; the panel and launcher can change it later, and the plugin remembers the last choice.
visibility.label: Visibility

visibility.desc_everyone: Every device on the network sees you and can ask to send.
visibility.desc_favorites: You do not announce yourself. Only pinned devices can send; requests from others are declined. An active network scan still shows your name. Hidden mode hides you completely.
visibility.desc_hidden: Receiver off: nobody finds you or sends you anything. You can still send; Refresh asks only your favorites, which then learn about you.
visibility.draining: The receiver turns off once the current incoming transfer ends.
visibility.no_favorites: You have no pinned devices yet, so nobody can send to you now.
visibility.title: Visibility: {mode}
